title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description: <p><strong>REQ ID:</strong> FEQ227R147</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based)</p> <p><strong>Recruiter:</strong> Dina Hussain</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our <strong>EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups </strong>business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.</li> <li>Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.</li> <li>Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.</li> <li>Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.</li> <li>Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. As such, it is ideally suited for a strategist who is keen to develop a broader skillset than media alone, as well as gain experience managing senior client stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Whilst your average to do list will vary from day to day, typical responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading strategic responses, narratives for pitches as well as delivering genuine data-driven insight to client teams</li> <li>Delivering key internal strategic workstreams, planning and insight training as well as encouraging agency creativity and innovation</li> <li>Present work in agency forums, lead agency brainstorms as well as identify and develop award entries</li> <li>Staying up to date with trends and sharing this with strategy teams alongside contributing to thought pieces and external events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>We are most interested in your ability to articulate the client’s challenge succinctly and turn that into actionable instructions for media planning teams. The skillset and experience you may have had to get to this point may vary but in general will include:</li> <ul> <li>Both ATL and Digital media channel knowledge</li> <li>The gravitas to be a trusted strategic partner to key clients</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships across the agency</li> <li>Understanding of effectiveness best practice and a willing to improvise to deliver competitive advantage</li> <li>Most importantly, you will be curious, clear and creative in your thinking, writing and speaking.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. title: Director, Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3594 - Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at Wavemaker. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p>Wavemaker UK is looking for a Director, Planning to join our growing planning team, to drive forward our planning output and help to create amazing work for our clients.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Media Planning Craft: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Wavemaker planning output on your specific client to create unrivalled work.</li> <li>Be able to articulate the strategic approach into media behaviours and train and support the wider team.</li> <li>Need strategic thinking on how we utilise tools and specialism outside of planning on response i.e. sources of growth, measurement, learning agenda, data, etc</li> <li>Build presence outside of current teams and drive visibility of planning team within the wider agency.</li> <li>Bring a fresh perspective to planning approaches including the use of different tools, new insights and coach others to challenge the status quo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overall responsibility for the development of all planning responses, ensuring we are developing unrivalled work in all executions.</li> <li>Manage senior client relationships, understanding what they need for their business and how to drive growth for them.</li> <li>Manage the planning team ensuring the have clear personal objectives, structure and regular reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Idea creation and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and develop relationship with media owners and look for opportunities to create unrivalled work</li> <li>Have an advanced commercial understanding of Wavemakers products and services. Understanding which are suitable for their clients and how sell in solutions.</li> <li>Be a story telling expert, driving added value with the team and quality boosting output.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Practice Area Knowledge – Advanced- </strong>Demonstrates advanced understanding of the industry as well as future trends Serves as an internal consultant/expert on at least some tools and technology.</p> <p>Effectively guides junior team members on advanced elements.</p> <p>Works with leadership team to develop new solutions and/or spot new applications</p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Advanced -</strong> Performs complex analyses of a range of information and identifies issues before they become problems; helps others think about how to define or redefine complex problems. Supports business leaders to find solutions and evaluates others’ solutions to determine the best way forward. Understand how to resolve escalated issues and coaches others to problem solve. Manages escalations.</p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Management – Advanced - </strong>Capitalizes on deep understanding of (current or potential) client and agency organizational structures, business processes, strategic objectives and challenges in order to anticipate and meet their needs. Demonstrates expert knowledge and monitors the client’s industry and competitive environment in order to create effective solutions. Advises key stakeholders by continuously helping them to successfully navigate through critical business changes.​​​​​​​ Uses strong deep expertise and contextual awareness to explore complex issues with stakeholders and provide trusted advice, deliverables and campaign KPIs.</p> <p><strong>Effective Communication – Advanced - </strong>Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Expert -</strong> Sets the standard for accuracy and thoroughness so that sufficiently detailed information is logged correctly.&nbsp; Balances short-term considerations with long-term goals and ensures that critical deliverables are met.&nbsp; Manages multiple overlapping timelines and competing demands, weighing the needs of different stakeholders across the business to determine priorities for parallel projects and sets priorities according to business needs.</p> <p><strong>Compelling storytelling – Advanced -</strong> Lead and direct the creation of a story, taking into account client knowledge levels and needs. Applies deep expertise and sound judgement to persuade key decision makers on recommendation, considering all implications. Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation, etc.) for various internal and external audiences.</p> <p><strong>Ideas Creation – Expert - </strong>Develops strategies to bring new technologies, innovations and products to life.&nbsp; Challenges the client and team in innovating and designing new solutions, methods and products to remain competitive and lead the industry.</p> <p><strong>Comms Planning – Advanced -</strong> High technical knowledge of all media touchpoints as well as how they interplay and future trends.&nbsp; Serves as a consultant and quality controls plans, strategies and frameworks that leave the building.&nbsp; Strategic learnings and insights about business impact (not just media metrics).&nbsp; Development of directional media strategy/platform.&nbsp; Developing comms planning skills amongst wider community.&nbsp; Looks for alternative solutions to problems and constantly challenges received norms in a spirit of positive provocation.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. title: Head of Risk Operations
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team: Risk Operations is a global 1LOD team responsible for the Acquiring, Issuing and Credit Risk domains. The team handles cases and investigations across product domains, working closely with 2LOD and Commercial teams to ensure that Airwallex operates within its risk appetite. The team is passionate about operational excellence and delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience. What you’ll do: As the Senior Director/Head of Risk Operations, you will lead a global team responsible for defining procedures and delivering operational excellence across new client onboarding, periodic review and in-life behaviour. You will ensure that Airwallex champions high standards for integrity, judgement and documentation in all aspects of risk operations. Responsibilities: Own the vision, strategy and execution for Risk Operations Build, lead and develop high-performing a globally distributed team Own the location and resourcing strategy of the team, solving for 24/7 coverage, quality of customer experience and cost efficiency Create a repeatable & scalable operating rhythm, including clear OKRs Take a data-driven approach to performance management Strike the right balance between risk, customer experience and commercial impact, ensuring timely, high-quality decision making and communications Drive continuous improvement in the quality of procedures, playbooks and control frameworks, aligned to Airwallex financial crime and fraud policies defined by 2LOD and partnering closely with Risk Product and Engineering Ensure that Airwallex continues to improve the quality and consistency of documentation Lead AI transformation of the Risk Operations team This role will be based in either London or Singapore. holistically rather than locally.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>At Wolt, this role provides a rare opportunity to work on <strong>challenging AdTech problems at scale</strong>, where technical decisions directly impact revenue and user experience.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a <strong>total compensation model</strong>, combining a competitive base salary with DoorDash RSUs.</p> <p>You description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow. We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation. YOUR MISSION As Campaign Operations Manager, your mission will be to own the successful delivery and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns from initial planning through to post-campaign analysis. You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights. Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end delivery of digital advertising campaigns, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis. Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives. Monitor campaign performance and proactively optimise activity to improve delivery and results. Troubleshoot campaign issues, resolve blockers and minimise delivery and revenue risk. Produce high-quality campaign reports and post-campaign analysis decks that translate performance data into clear, actionable insights. Present campaign performance, findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external clients when required. Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners. Identify commercial opportunities, including campaign upweights, extensions and improvements that could deliver additional value for clients and Carwow. Continuously review Campaign Operations processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability. Support the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards. KEY REQUIREMENTS Experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad-tech environment. Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign setup, optimisation, delivery and reporting. Experience using an ad server or campaign management platform, ideally Google Ad Manager. Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations. A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving problems and improving campaign performance. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work. Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance clearly. A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how effective campaign management supports revenue and client retention. A collaborative, adaptable mindset and an interest in improving processes through technology, automation and AI. BONUS POINTS Experience working within the automotive, publishing or digital media industry. Knowledge of programmatic advertising, paid social, YouTube or off-site display campaigns. Experience with demand-generation or lead-generation campaigns. Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms. Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects. WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities. You’ll need to be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, taking ownership and proactively identifying potential issues before they affect delivery. You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes. description: <p><strong>Associate Director, Supply Chain</strong></p> <p><strong>Company:</strong>&nbsp; Cycle Pharmaceuticals Ltd</p> <p><strong>Position Summary: </strong>This is a full-time position leading our Supply Chain department, working in our Cambridge office on a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days in the office).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You’ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.</p> <p>This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.</p> <p>This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company's growth.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Company&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that <strong>Every Single Patient Matters</strong>. This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we’re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.</p> <p>Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. leadership and governance forums.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed </strong><strong>in this role:</strong></p> <ul> including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.</li> <li>Knowledge of GDP, DSCSA, serialisation, and global pharmaceutical supply chain regulations.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional projects, product launches, and business-critical supply chain initiatives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex external partnerships.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, leadership, description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our London office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>This role is based in London.</p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote from London. Once Pallet opens its London office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Coffee Chat with Sales Team - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits&nbsp;</li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office&nbsp;</li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided&nbsp;</li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.</p> <p>Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.&nbsp;</p> <p>Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. across different types of social platforms.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement robust, data-driven social media&nbsp;and digital impact across the relevant digital landscape.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Translate performance data, intelligence, and&nbsp;stakeholder&nbsp;sentiment into actionable strategic recommendations that directly inspire and inform innovative creative development, campaign optimisation, and future content planning.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>At the client level:&nbsp;Leverage&nbsp;our suite of tools to&nbsp;anticipate&nbsp;threats&nbsp;and inform innovative strategic pivots&nbsp;for our colleagues&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <ul> <li>We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. We’re looking for:</li> <li>Curious, proactive individuals who are keen to learn and grow</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Strong relationship-building ability, both internally and externally</li> <li>Analytical mindset, comfortable interpreting data and creating insights – proficiency in Excel!</li> <li>Organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously</li> <li>Solving problems for customers</li> <li>Interest in emerging technologies and excited by the potential and opportunity AI brings</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Values and Principles</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</li> <li>Seek inclusion &amp; Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by over $55 million from top-tier investors like Sequoia Capital, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

L'équipe

L'équipe d'Account Management joue un rôle stratégique au sein de la business unit "revente" de Zefir, servant de liaison entre Zefir et ses agents immobiliers partenaires. Leur objectif principal est de maximiser la performance des agents pour vendre un maximum de biens, tout en offrant une expérience optimale tant aux agents qu'aux vendeurs.

Le rôle et tes challenges

🏠 Gérer un portefeuille d'agents immobiliers partenaires et les aider à atteindre nos objectifs de vente.

📊 Analyser les performances des agents, détecter leurs axes d'amélioration et proposer des actions concrètes pour améliorer leurs résultats (coaching, ajustement de stratégie, outils).

💡 Identifier les ressources nécessaires pour intervenir dans une transaction au moment opportun.

🤝 Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Sales pour stimuler la croissance de l'entreprise.

À propos de toi

💜 Tu pourrais être un excellent atout pour Zefir si tu es doté(e) de compétences solides en gestion de comptes, coaching, et analyse de performance. Tu es capable de travailler avec différents profils d’agents, de comprendre leurs besoins et de les guider pour les amener à réussir.

Expérience souhaitée :

🎓 Diplôme de Licence/Master en commerce ou dans des domaines connexes.

💼 Plus de 3 ans d'expérience en Sales et/ou en Account Management.

🤝 Expérience dans la création de relations de confiance avec des clients.

🏆 Expérience dans la promotion de la réussite client dans un environnement "gagner en équipe".

Avantages

💵 Salaire attractif : salaire fixe annuel entre 47k€ et 52k€, avec un variable déplafonné à objectif atteint entre 16 et 18K.

💸 BSPCE (Stock Options): vesting chaque mois après la 1ère année, sur 4 ans.

💚 Healthcare plan: assurance santé Alan (100% couverts pour les membres de l’équipe, les partenaires et leurs enfants).

🏡 Bureaux à Le Peletier, Paris (9e), avec télétravail partiel autorisé.

🥗 Carte restaurant Swile: 11€/jour travaillé.

🛴 Carte de mobilité Swile : 42€/mois pour tes besoins de mobilité durable (abonnements métro, covoiturage, vélo…).

🎉 Evénements : “Monthly Mixer” pour partager des moments conviviaux et les “All Hands” pour revenir sur les réussites des équipes.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien téléphonique (30 min) : Découverte de ton parcours et de tes motivations.

  2. Questions écrites : Quelques questions pour mieux te connaître et te challenger sur une mission concrète.

  3. Entretien sur site (≈2h) : Entretien sur tes compétences Sales/Account Management, suivi d'une rencontre avec l'un des fondateurs de Zefir.

  4. Ref Calls, feedback final et proposition : Retour sur les entretiens et proposition de rôle si nous pensons que tu es le talent qu'il nous faut !


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

Compensation: €63K – €70K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

raw.description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

title: Geologist
description: About the company The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition. Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible. About the job As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio. This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools. What you'll do Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include: Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. Assist with field logistics while ensuring compliance with international health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards. Data Compilation & QA/QC: Lead geological data entry, compilation, and QA/QC processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of exploration datasets across all projects. Office Work: Assist senior geologists with geological data interpretation to support exploration targeting, field campaign planning, technical reporting, GIS mapping, data management, and project evaluation. Contribute to the preparation of maps, presentations, and technical documentation. Bridge Geology & AI Tech: Work closely with the tech and AI teams to test, refine, and improve Lithosquare’s AI platform, ensuring our digital tools reflect field realities and technical needs. Reporting & Collaboration: Prepare clear technical summaries, data visualizations, and maps for internal reviews and partner updates. What we are looking for Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences , with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables Mission-driven: Passionate about the energy transition and solving complex physical-world challenges through innovation Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges Valid Driver's License (Permis B) is a bonus Perks & Benefits 🏢 Offices located in the heart of Paris 🌱 Strong culture of ownership & entrepreneurship 🌍 Opportunity to significantly contribute to energy transition 👥 Collaborative work environment with world-class experts in geology, AI, and data science 🔄 Flexible work arrangements enabling work-life balance 🚴 Sustainable mobility allowance ( Forfait Mobilité Durable ) 🏋️ Gym pass 🎉 Frequent team drinks, events & regular off-sites 💰 Competitive salary package 🍽️ Meal vouchers and health insurance coverage (Alan) Join Lithosquare and become part of a passionate team driving innovation at the intersection of AI and Earth exploration. Let's make a tangible difference together! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Internal tooling is not a backlog item at Prelude — it's a strategic lever. As we scale from 50 to a much larger team, the speed at which engineering, ops, sales, support, and finance can operate depends on the tools we put in their hands.

You'll own that surface. You'll build the internal tools and AI-powered automation that make every team at Prelude move faster, ship with confidence, and spend their time on the work that actually matters. You'll work directly with internal stakeholders to find friction and turn it into functional, reliable software — and you'll be our edge in AI engineering, evaluating and integrating the tools that define how a modern company operates. Here are some examples of projects :

  • Interconnect the various internal tools we use (hubspot, linear, plain and more)

  • Optimize the way we calculate and aggregate our billing

  • Build flows and use AI to automate our internal processes (invoicing/reporting/support)

This is a high-ownership IC role on the Platform team, with direct access to your internal customers from day one.

What will you be doing?

  • Owning the design, development, and maintenance of internal tools used daily across engineering, ops, product, sales, support, and finance

  • Building agentic AI workflows that automate repetitive internal processes and unlock new capabilities for our teams (fraud review, customer support triage, GTM workflows, ops dashboards, and more)

  • Working directly with stakeholders across all teams to identify friction and turn it into functional solutions, with feedback loops measured in days, not quarters

  • Evaluating and integrating the latest AI engineering tools (Claude, Cursor, n8n, Dust, and whatever comes next) and setting the standard for how Prelude leverages them internally

  • Contributing to our polyglot codebase and collaborating with the broader engineering team on shared infrastructure, schemas, and APIs

  • Designing and building internal dashboards on top of our data layer (DynamoDB, Clickhouse and Postgres) to give every team visibility into what they need to act on

  • Participating in on-call rotations for the internal platform you build

What are we looking for?

  • Software engineer with experience shipping in high-paced environments and a track record of finishing what you start

  • You've shipped automated workflows and AI-powered tools in production (n8n, Dust, custom LLM pipelines, or equivalent), not just prototyped with them

  • You've built for internal users before and understand that reliability matters more than polish — but that good UX still earns you adoption

  • Solid backend skills in Go or TypeScript, with the ability to design and build reliable APIs and services

  • Comfortable working across the stack — React on the frontend when the tool needs a UI, plus the data layer (DynamoDB, SQS, Lambdas) underneath

  • A preference for simplicity vs complexity, with intuition for what will scale effectively as the company grows

  • A product-led mindset — you code for outcomes and impact, and you can talk to a non-engineer stakeholder without translating from engineer-speak

  • Fluent/professional English given our international team

  • Experience with developer experience or platform engineering

  • Familiarity with fintech, identity, fraud, or another regulated/high-stakes domain

  • Experience integrating with common SaaS APIs (CRM, billing, support, data warehouse)

  • Any experience with Rust, gRPC, or AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS) is a plus

  • Primary: Go, TypeScript, React

  • Codebase and data: Go services, Next.js, gRPC, DynamoDB, SQS, Redshift, Lambdas

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems. As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Making Sense of Data Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals. Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams. Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions. Building Data Products Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably. Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale. Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models. Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand. Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work. Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions. Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result. From Data to Intelligence Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter. Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem. Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability. Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production. Continuous Improvement Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure. Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies. Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack. About H:

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

The role:

We are looking for a Catalyst: an exceptional entrepreneurial operator who can enter ambiguous, high-stakes situations and create progress fast.

This is not a traditional strategy, operations, product, or project management role. You will work directly with leadership and cross-functional teams to identify what matters, structure the problem, align the right people, and drive execution until the outcome is delivered.

We are looking for someone who can think like a strategist, move like a founder, and execute like an owner.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead high-priority strategic and operational projects from start to finish, including product launches, enterprise deployments, GTM initiatives, partnerships, internal operations, or new business opportunities.

  • Turn ambiguity into clear action, by structuring complex problems, gathering signal, defining priorities, preparing recommendations, and aligning stakeholders around the right path forward.

  • Drive execution hands-on, removing bottlenecks, coordinating across product, engineering, research, GTM and operations, and personally doing whatever is needed to move critical topics forward.

  • Within your first months, you will have taken ownership of several high-impact topics with limited guidance. You will have helped leadership make better and faster decisions, unblocked complex cross-functional initiatives, and raised the operating level of the company through clarity, pace, and accountability.

Requirements:

  • Outstanding track record in a demanding environment, such as venture capital, top-tier strategy consulting, a Chief of Staff role, a fast-growing startup, founder/operator experience, product strategy, or business operations.

  • Exceptional ownership, autonomy, and execution speed, with the ability to operate without a playbook, make progress with incomplete information, and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and interpersonal skills, with the ability to break down complex topics, communicate clearly, influence senior stakeholders, and build trust across technical and business teams.

You Might Be a Fit If

  • You are a former founder, VC, Chief of Staff, strategy consultant, or high-performing startup operator.

  • You have been the person founders or executives call when something is important, messy, and urgent.

  • You are intellectually sharp, deeply proactive, hands-on, and energized by speed, ambiguity, and high expectations.

  • You need a clearly defined scope before starting.

  • You prefer advising over owning.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary.

  • Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development.

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters. Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases. Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before. Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up. Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together. Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running. AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity. Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability. Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts. Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench. Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping. raw.title: AI Engineer
raw.description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note:

  • We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
  • Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

About cogify group

cogify was founded in Switzerland in 2018 and today combines expertise in consulting, AI, software engineering, cybersecurity and digital products.

We are expanding our cybersecurity capabilities and are looking for a Cybersecurity Architect with a strong focus on Zero Trust who understands complex IT environments and can translate security requirements into practical, implementable solutions.

Your Mission

As a Cybersecurity Architect, you work at the interface between business, security, technology and delivery.

You understand the challenges our customers face, assess existing environments and identify where security needs to evolve.

You combine consulting skills with strong technical expertise – from the first assessment and target architecture through technology selection and implementation together with our engineering teams.

You ask the right questions, challenge existing assumptions and communicate confidently with stakeholders from management to engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Assess existing IT and security environments and identify risks, gaps and improvement opportunities
  • Design Zero Trust and enterprise security target architectures
  • Develop practical security roadmaps and implementation concepts
  • Advise customers on security architecture, Zero Trust strategy and technology selection
  • Design solutions across IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network segmentation, cloud and endpoint security
  • Evaluate security technologies, products and licensing models against customer requirements
  • Translate business, security and compliance requirements into technically implementable solutions
  • Lead security workshops and architecture discussions with customers
  • Support implementation together with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps and software engineers
  • Help shape and further develop cogify’s cybersecurity offering

Your Profile

  • Experience in cybersecurity architecture, security engineering, cybersecurity consulting or a comparable role
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architectures, technologies and principles
  • Good knowledge of frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model or comparable approaches
  • Strong knowledge of areas such as IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network security, segmentation, cloud security and access control
  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise security solutions
  • Ability to evaluate security technologies and select appropriate solutions for specific requirements
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networks, identity, authentication and cloud environments
  • Ability to translate complex security topics into clear decisions and practical solutions
  • Confident communication with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Independent, pragmatic and quality-focused way of working
  • Fluent English or German is required

Nice to Have

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, ISSAP or comparable qualifications
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments
  • German, French or other languages in addition to your primary working language

We offer a competitive salary, a flexible working environment, modern technologies and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

We are looking for people who ask good questions, understand complex systems and want to build security solutions that work in practice.
